# artie_kafka_user (Resource)

Artie Managed Kafka user resource. This represents a SASL/SCRAM-SHA-512 login for a Managed Kafka cluster; Artie generates its password. Users can't be changed, so changing any argument forces a new user (and a new password).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "artie_kafka_user" "consumer" {
  cluster_uuid = artie_kafka_cluster.example.uuid
  username     = "my-app"
}

resource "artie_kafka_user" "admin" {
  cluster_uuid   = artie_kafka_cluster.example.uuid
  username       = "ops-admin"
  access_profile = "admin"
}

output "consumer_password" {
  value     = artie_kafka_user.consumer.password
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Managed Kafka cluster the user logs in to. Changing this forces a new user.
- `username` (String) The username clients log in with. Changing this forces a new user.

### Optional

- `access_profile` (String) What the user can do. `producer_consumer` (the default) can read every topic under your company's prefix, which includes all data Artie replicates, and write to topics under your customer prefix. `admin` has cluster-wide Kafka ACLs, including every replicated topic. Changing this forces a new user.

### Read-Only

- `consumer_group_prefix` (String) The prefix the user's consumer group IDs must start with.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The user's SCRAM-SHA-512 password, generated by Artie.
- `status` (String) The user's status, e.g. `active`.
- `uuid` (String) The unique identifier for this Kafka user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a Managed Kafka user by using its cluster's UUID and its own UUID, separated by a slash. You can find them by:
# 1. Go to the Kafka clusters page in the Artie UI (https://app.artie.com) and click on the cluster
# 2. Copy the cluster's UUID, then copy the user's UUID from the cluster's users
terraform import artie_kafka_user.example <kafka_cluster_uuid>/<kafka_user_uuid>
```
